entities.name: Q6F1Z2 uL23
observations: Exact full-length sequence match (94 aa) to reviewed Mesoplasma florum large ribosomal subunit protein uL23, UniProt Q6F1Z2.
uL23 binds 23S rRNA, is part of the 50S subunit near the polypeptide exit tunnel, and provides a docking site for trigger factor.
Pfam Ribosomal_L23 domain PF00276.26 detected at residues 5–90 (i-E-value 5.4e-33).
Sequence-derived estimates: mass 10,864.535 Da, pI 9.521, charge at pH 7 +4.6868, GRAVY -0.4436, instability index 32.534.
